[ ![Hot Wheels Wiki](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/e/e6/Site-logo.png/revision/latest?cb=20231014034307) ](https://hotwheels.fandom.com/wiki/Hot_Wheels)

Hot Wheels's **design team** (colloquially known as the **Hot Wheels Dream Team**) comprises of casting designers, graphic designers and packaging designers.

## Current[]
